{{Quote|I ate the wrong kind of shellfish on Pamina Prime. Turns out it's the blue-shelled mollusk with the green stripe you need to watch out for. Blue mollusks with black stripes you can eat till you burst. Just a little tip to stand you in good stead, if ever you find yourself on Pamina Prime.|[[Taria Damsin]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Pamina Prime''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was home to [[Shellfish/Legends|shellfish]] that were responsible of a deadly disease when eaten, the [[Borotavi syndrome]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Taria Damsin]] was diagnosed with this disease after eating a local blue-shelled mollusk with a green stripe.
